description: "GitHub Issues, sub-issues, and GitHub Projects to track tasks, dependencies, and progress on collaborative projects."

:::{.callout-learning}

After completing this session, you will be able to:

- Create issues in GitHub for documentation and to track specific, actionable tasks
- Utilize GitHub Issues and Sub-issues to manage and track project tasks
- Explain in what contexts GitHub Projects are useful
- Compare the benefits the three available project view options
- Explain how GitHub Issues and GitHub Projects relate to each other
